name: PokAidle: The Everfall Chronicles
storyline:
It started in Viridian Forest. A mysterious spatial distortion known as "The Everfall" has fractured the Kanto region. The familiar cities and routes have extended infinitely downwards, becoming dangerous, never-ending dungeons.

Professor Oak has recruited you to investigate. The Gym Leaders have taken up posts deep within these distorted zones to prevent the wild Pokémon from overrunning the surface. As a new trainer, your goal isn't just to earn badges—it's to explore the depths, stabilize the zones, and uncover the mystery behind the Everfall.
summary:
The Kanto Region... Reimagined as an Infinite Dungeon.

Dive into a nostalgic yet fresh experience where Generation 1 meets Idle RPG.
The "Everfall" phenomenon has twisted the world, turning familiar routes into endless gauntlets. Can you build the perfect team to conquer infinity?
